discussion.body: Build study, not clothes. Same face as the existing Ash plate (Breakwoods / Brass Lands half-orc, green-olive, braids, tusks). Tallest living roster body, heavy athletic not cartoon bulk. Undershirt and shorts. Invasion is hunger, not a race verdict. Local: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-033-ash-korv-build-study.jpg. Existing clothed plate stays.
